releases.title: Alkebuleum Launches as Africa's Sovereign Trust Infrastructure, Opens Founding Council to Reputable Institutions
releases.summary: The Alkebuleum Foundation announces the public launch of the Alkebuleum network — a Layer 1 public, permissioned blockchain purpose-built for the African continent and its global diaspora — alongside an open invitation to reputable institutions to join the Alkebuleum Founding Council.
